text.en: Local pet owners commend the staff for their warm welcome and patient advice whenever they visit the shop. Reviewers note that team members take extra time to assist with pet needs and help pick out suitable aquarium livestock. The shop is widely regarded as a caring community fixture.

Customers describe this Fulham shop as a treasure trove stocking high-quality toys, accessories, and raw dog foods. Visitors specifically praise the dedicated basement department featuring a diverse variety of healthy tropical fish. The tidy shop layout makes browsing convenient for local residents.

Shoppers appreciate that the team genuinely prioritises pet welfare, offering healthy fish and nutritious food options. One client particularly highlights how accommodating and thoughtful the staff were towards their disabled dog. Customers feel confident bringing their pets into the store.

q.en: Does The Fish Bowl carry tropical fish?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight the basement aquatic department offering a wide selection of healthy tropical fish and accessories.

q.en: Are raw pet foods available in store?

a.en: Yes, customers mention that the shop stocks quality raw foods alongside treats and toys for dogs.

q.en: Is the shop open on Sundays?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the store opens on Sundays from 10:00 to 15:00 for local shoppers.

q.en: Can visitors bring their dogs inside?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report that pets are warmly welcomed and accommodated by the friendly store team.
